name: The Daypack
summary: A backpack, 20 L, with a front pouch and a side bottle holder built in, and rails on the front for a laptop sleeve. Water-resistant. 60-month warranty. £129.
concept: A plain backpack with a front pouch clipped on and a bottle holder sewn into the side. Two vertical rails on the front take a laptop sleeve. It has one main compartment.
why_it_exists: Most bags make you carry a bottle and small things loose. This one has a pouch and a bottle holder already on it.
target_customer: Commuters and walkers who carry the same few things every day.

physical.form: A rounded rectangular backpack with one zipped main compartment, a padded back and two vertical rails on the front, each 24 mm wide with 12 slots.
materials: Closed-cell foam back panel with air mesh

features: It comes with a front pouch and a side bottle holder, so your keys and a bottle have a place.
The two rails on the front take a laptop sleeve, which is sold separately.
The fabric is recycled and water-resistant, so it copes with a rainy walk to work.
The main compartment opens with one long zip, so you can see everything at once.
The padded back keeps it comfortable and stops the contents digging in.
It has a 60-month warranty, which is five years of us standing behind it.
arrives: The bag is folded flat into a recycled-paper bag with a card hangtag, with no plastic wrap. A Laptop Sleeve, if you ordered one, comes in its own paper sleeve. A folded guide inside shows how to clip it onto the rails.
specs: 44 x 29 x 15 cm (height x width x depth)
Recycled polyester with a water-resistant coating, foam and air-mesh back panel, nylon buckles, metal zips
Off-white with lilac and sunflower yellow accents
Padded, up to 14-inch. A 16-inch laptop does not fit.
Front pouch 13 x 10 x 4 cm (holds a Blip, keys and a wallet). Side bottle holder up to 75 mm wide.
Two on the front, 24 mm wide, 12 slots each, 140 mm apart. 1.5 kg per module.
Sheds light rain, not waterproof. Maximum load 9 kg. Wipe clean, do not machine wash.
how_it_works: The front pouch is already clipped to the rails. To add a Laptop Sleeve, push its two clips into the rail slots until they click. To remove one, lift the tab and pull.
in_the_box: The Daypack with its front pouch and side bottle holder
A folded care and rail guide

accessories.name: Laptop Sleeve
accessories.tagline: A padded sleeve for a laptop.
accessories.description: A padded sleeve for a laptop up to 14 inches. It clips on to the Daypack's front rails or sits inside the main compartment. A 16-inch laptop does not fit it.
specs: 14-inch (about 32 x 23 cm and up to 2 cm thick). A 16-inch laptop does not fit.
Recycled polyester outer, foam padding, nylon zip
Off-white with a pink zip, orange zip pull and a sky blue loop
The Daypack's front rails and main compartment. Also works on its own as a sleeve.
Wipe with a damp cloth. Do not machine wash.

compatibility.note: It fits a laptop up to 14-inch.
It does not fit the Daypack or the Laptop Sleeve.
It comes with the bag. It holds a Blip, keys and a wallet.
It comes with the bag. It holds bottles up to 75 mm wide.
It fits the front pouch. It does not fit the side bottle holder.
It is too big for the front pouch. It fits in the main compartment.

packaging: Folded in a recycled-paper bag with a card hangtag. No plastic wrap. The Laptop Sleeve comes in a paper sleeve.

warranty.summary: It has a 60-month warranty against faults in how it was made, including zips, seams, buckles and rails. Normal wear, overloading and repairs by anyone else are not covered. See Warranty.

care: Wipe with a damp cloth and mild soap. Do not machine wash.
Air dry away from direct heat.
Do not re-proof with solvent-based sprays.
Rub a stiff zip with a candle, not oil.
safety: It is not waterproof. Keep electronics in the inner pocket in heavy rain.
Each rail holds 1.5 kg. Do not hang heavy items from them.
Do not carry more than 9 kg.

delivery.note: Soon or Sooner. Soon is free over £50.

returnable.note: You can return it within 30 days if it is unused and in its box. See Returns.

sections.title: One size
sections.body: 20 L, £129. It holds a laptop up to 14-inch, a bottle and lunch. A 16-inch laptop does not fit.

sections.title: Pouch and bottle holder
sections.body: A front pouch and a side bottle holder come with the bag. The rails on the front take a Laptop Sleeve if you want one.

sections.title: Fabric
sections.body: It is recycled polyester with a water-resistant coating. It sheds light rain, but it is not waterproof.

faq.a: 20 L. The laptop pocket takes up to 14-inch.
No. It sheds light rain. Keep electronics in the inner pocket in heavy rain.

faq.q: What fits in the front pouch?
faq.a: A Blip, keys and a wallet. Boombox Mini is too big. The pouch comes with the bag.

faq.q: Does it come with a bottle holder?
faq.a: Yes. A bottle holder is sewn into the side. It takes a bottle up to 75 mm wide.

faq.q: How much can each rail hold?

faq.a: Faults in how it was made for 60 months, including zips, seams, buckles and rails.

steps: Clear any fabric or dirt from the teeth.
Rub a candle along the teeth. Do not use oil.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: Open a support case. A new zip is £25 through The Fix Club, or free if it is a warranty fault.

troubleshooting.problem: The Laptop Sleeve or front pouch will not stay on the rails.
steps: Push both clips fully into slots on the same row until they click.
Do not load an add-on over 1.5 kg.
The Fix Club fits a new buckle for £8.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: If it broke under normal use within 60 months, it is covered. Open a support case.

photography_direction: Sculptural and calm. The front pouch and the side bottle holder are part of the bag. Show the bag as it ships.
